aka.en: Camino Nacional México–Nuevo Laredo; Carretera Nacional No. 1
aka.zh: 墨西哥城—新拉雷多国道；1 号国道

aka.en: Carretera Panamericana (the original Pan-American route to the border)
aka.zh: 泛美公路（通往边境的最初泛美线路）
国道（Carretera Nacional，新莱昂州的叫法）

tagline.en: Mexico's first road to the United States, routed through the mountains on purpose to stay away from the railway
tagline.zh: 墨西哥第一条通往美国的公路——为了避开铁路，有意穿山而行

start.en: Indios Verdes, Gustavo A. Madero, in northern Mexico City — kilometre 6 of the original chainage, which was measured from the central door of the National Palace
start.zh: 墨西哥城北部古斯塔沃·A·马德罗区的印第安绿人像（Indios Verdes）——原里程桩号的 6 公里处，里程原自国家宫正门起算

end.en: Nuevo Laredo, Tamaulipas, at the Gateway to the Americas International Bridge to Laredo, Texas, where the road meets the business loop of Interstate 35
end.zh: 塔毛利帕斯州新拉雷多，经美洲门户国际桥通往得克萨斯州拉雷多，在此连接 35 号州际公路的商业环线

en: Federal Highway 85 leaves Mexico City north-east through Ecatepec to Pachuca, runs by Actopan and Ixmiquilpan, then drops off the plateau through the Sierra Madre Oriental by Zimapán and Jacala to Tamazunchale in the Huasteca of San Luis Potosí. From there it runs north through Ciudad Valles, Ciudad Mante and Ciudad Victoria in Tamaulipas, Linares and Montemorelos in Nuevo León, through Monterrey, and over the Mamulique pass by Sabinas Hidalgo to Nuevo Laredo.

It was the first road in Mexico to join the capital to the United States border and the original Pan-American route, and it was laid out to avoid the existing railway through Querétaro, San Luis Potosí and Saltillo. The price was distance. Spanish Wikipedia notes that the road is now little used for traffic to the border, because the mountain crossing makes it considerably longer than Highway 57, and the modern trunk corridor from Mexico City to Nuevo Laredo, as the federal development bank describes it, includes the México–Querétaro motorway at the start of Highway 57. Highway 85 is a large road only at its two ends: a six-lane divided road from Monterrey to Nuevo Laredo and four lanes from Pachuca to the capital.

Sources give the length as 1,213 km (English Wikipedia, from the 2011 state traffic tables) or 1,225 km (Spanish Wikipedia). The 1936 ministry account fixed it at 1,231.740 km, from the National Palace to the middle of the international bridge.
zh: 85 号联邦公路自墨西哥城向东北经埃卡特佩克至帕丘卡，经阿克托潘和伊斯米基尔潘，随后经锡马潘和哈卡拉穿越东马德雷山脉、走下高原，抵达圣路易斯波托西州瓦斯特卡地区的塔马送查莱。由此向北，经巴耶斯城、塔毛利帕斯州的曼特城和维多利亚城，新莱昂州的利纳雷斯和蒙特莫雷洛斯，穿过蒙特雷，经萨维纳斯伊达尔戈越过马穆利克山口，抵达新拉雷多。

它是墨西哥第一条把首都与美国边境连接起来的公路，也是最初的泛美公路线路；其走向刻意避开了经克雷塔罗、圣路易斯波托西和萨尔蒂约的既有铁路。代价是距离。西班牙文维基百科指出，由于翻越山脉使其里程明显长于 57 号公路，这条路如今很少用于前往边境的交通；按联邦开发银行的说法，如今的墨西哥城—新拉雷多干线走廊包括 57 号公路起点的墨西哥城—克雷塔罗高速。85 号公路只在两端是大路：蒙特雷至新拉雷多为双向六车道分隔道路，帕丘卡至首都为四车道。
各方给出的长度为 1,213 公里（英文维基百科，依据 2011 年各州交通数据表）或 1,225 公里（西班牙文维基百科）。1936 年交通部的工程纪要将其定为 1,231.740 公里，自国家宫起算至国际桥的中点。

en: The road was the first project of the National Roads Commission, created in 1925 under President Plutarco Elías Calles. In August 1925 five brigades of engineers were sent to compare a central and an eastern route between Mexico City and Ciudad Victoria; the western option was dropped because two railways already served it. The two ends were built first: Mexico City–Pachuca, opened in 1926, and Nuevo Laredo–Monterrey, finished by mid-1927 and opened to tourist traffic that year. The route through Hidalgo, San Luis Potosí, Tamaulipas and Nuevo León was chosen in 1927, and the final alignment across the Sierra Madre between Zimapán and Tamazunchale was settled in 1928.

The mountain section took longest. Provisional roads were built between 1927 and 1929 so that the line could open as soon as possible, and in 1931 they were authorised for traffic; on 12 May 1931 the minister of communications, Juan Andreu Almazán, set off a blast at Tamazunchale that cleared the last large rock from the line. Much of it was still unpaved, and in 1932 the roads directorate cancelled the contracts of construction companies that had missed their deadlines and hired contractors by the piece to finish the work. By the ministry's account, President Lázaro Cárdenas had the line routed through Zimapán so that the town would not be left isolated.

The road was inaugurated on 1 July 1936 at the international bridge between Laredo and Nuevo Laredo. US Vice-President John N. Garner and Ambassador Josephus Daniels led the American party; by the ministry's account Cárdenas welcomed it by radio from the National Palace and gave a banquet for it at Chapultepec Castle. A motorcade drove the road to the capital over the following days. When the federal highways were later numbered, the road became Highway 85.
zh: 这条路是 1925 年普卢塔科·埃利亚斯·卡列斯总统任内成立的国家道路委员会的第一个项目。1925 年 8 月，五支工程师勘测队被派出，比较墨西哥城至维多利亚城之间的中线与东线方案；西线方案因已有两条铁路服务而被放弃。两端先行修建：墨西哥城—帕丘卡段 1926 年通车，新拉雷多—蒙特雷段 1927 年年中完工，当年即向游客开放。经伊达尔戈、圣路易斯波托西、塔毛利帕斯和新莱昂的走向于 1927 年确定，锡马潘至塔马送查莱之间穿越马德雷山的最终线位于 1928 年敲定。
山区段耗时最长。1927 至 1929 年间先修了临时道路，以求尽早通行，1931 年获准通车；1931 年 5 月 12 日，交通部长胡安·安德鲁·阿尔马桑在塔马送查莱引爆炸药，清除了线路上最后一块巨石。当时大部分路段仍未铺装；1932 年，道路局解除了未按期完工的施工公司的合同，改以计件方式雇用承包人完成剩余工程。据交通部的记述，拉萨罗·卡德纳斯总统要求线路经过锡马潘，以免该镇被孤立。
1936 年 7 月 1 日，公路在拉雷多与新拉雷多之间的国际桥上落成。美国副总统约翰·N·加纳和大使约瑟夫斯·丹尼尔斯率美方代表团出席；据交通部的记述，卡德纳斯在国家宫通过广播致欢迎辞，并在查普尔特佩克城堡设宴款待。随后几天，车队沿这条路驶抵首都。此后联邦公路统一编号时，这条路成为 85 号公路。

en: The hard part is the 282.1 km from the Colonia junction north of Pachuca to Tamazunchale, built from July 1929 to June 1936. In that distance the road descends from 2,400 metres at Colonia to 124 metres at Tamazunchale, crossing the ravines of Los Mármoles and La Encarnación on large embankments. Tamazunchale to Ciudad Victoria, 338.94 km, was the easiest section, though heavy rain and heat made the work hard, much of it done with scrapers and ploughs drawn by animals. North of Victoria the climbs are the Cuesta del Salero, the Cuesta de Garrapatas and the Margaritas grade, and at kilometre 1062 the Cuesta de Mamulique, whose winding line was later completely realigned with explosives.
zh: 最难的一段是自帕丘卡以北科洛尼亚岔口至塔马送查莱的 282.1 公里，1929 年 7 月至 1936 年 6 月建成。在这段距离内，公路自海拔 2,400 米的科洛尼亚降至海拔 124 米的塔马送查莱，以大体量路堤跨越洛斯马尔莫莱斯和拉恩卡纳西翁峡谷。塔马送查莱至维多利亚城的 338.94 公里施工最为简单，但多雨酷热使工程十分艰苦，许多土方是靠畜力牵引的铲运机和犁完成的。维多利亚城以北的爬坡依次为萨莱罗坡、加拉帕塔斯坡和马加丽塔斯坡；1062 公里处是马穆利克坡，其盘绕的线形后来用炸药全面改线。

en: The road cost about 62 million pesos by 1936; an academic study puts the total at over 63 million, and the ministry records a last tranche of 6.6 million spent before the opening. It was paid for from the national petrol tax, three centavos a litre, which raised more than 3 million pesos in 1925 and more than 13 million a year five years later; from a tax on manufactured tobacco; and from the federal communications budget, with the work let to private contractors. In 1927, 10 million pesos a year were set aside for the following four years to push the road south.

The tolled 85D between Monterrey and Nuevo Laredo was built under a concession of 28 July 1989 to the Protexa group for 146 km, and began operating in 1991. According to the Nuevo Laredo press, the first concession on the La Gloria–Monterrey section ran from 1991 to 2001 on the understanding that the road would then become free; it was instead renewed twice, to 2021, and the paper argued that users had paid for it several times over.
zh: 到 1936 年，这条路耗资约 6,200 万比索；一项学术研究称总额超过 6,300 万，交通部记载通车前最后一笔投入为 660 万。资金来自全国汽油税（每升 3 分，1925 年征得逾 300 万比索，五年后每年逾 1,300 万）、烟草制品税以及联邦交通预算，工程则发包给私营承包商。1927 年，政府为此后四年每年拨出 1,000 万比索，推动公路向南修建。
蒙特雷至新拉雷多的收费路 85D 依据 1989 年 7 月 28 日授予 Protexa 集团的 146 公里特许修建，1991 年开始运营。据新拉雷多媒体报道，拉格洛里亚—蒙特雷段的第一期特许为 1991 至 2001 年，原约定期满后免费通行；结果却两度续期至 2021 年。该报认为，用户已为这条路付了好几遍钱。

en: Between Nuevo Laredo and Monterrey the free road and the toll road run side by side; Spanish Wikipedia gives the toll on the 123.1 km 85D as 304 pesos in October 2023. At kilometre 26 south of Nuevo Laredo all vehicles leaving the border zone stop at the Garita Kilómetro 26 customs and immigration checkpoint. South of Linares the road narrows to two lanes and stays that way through rural Tamaulipas, the Huasteca and the Hidalgo mountains to Actopan. In July 2026 the ministry began a month of repainting on the steel Cómoca bridge on the Ciudad Valles–Tamazunchale section, with traffic alternating on one carriageway.
zh: 新拉雷多至蒙特雷之间，免费路与收费路并行；据西班牙文维基百科，123.1 公里的 85D 在 2023 年 10 月收费 304 比索。新拉雷多以南 26 公里处，所有驶离边境区的车辆都须在「26 公里检查站」（Garita Kilómetro 26）接受海关与移民检查。利纳雷斯以南道路收窄为双车道，穿过塔毛利帕斯乡村、瓦斯特卡地区和伊达尔戈山区，直到阿克托潘。2026 年 7 月，交通部开始对巴耶斯城—塔马送查莱段的科莫卡钢桥进行为期约一个月的涂装，期间车辆在单幅路面上交替通行。

timeline.en: The National Roads Commission is created; in August five survey brigades begin comparing routes to the border.
timeline.zh: 国家道路委员会成立；8 月，五支勘测队开始比选通往边境的线路。
墨西哥城—帕丘卡公路通车。

timeline.en: Nuevo Laredo–Monterrey is complete and opened to tourist traffic; the route through Hidalgo, San Luis Potosí and Tamaulipas is chosen.
timeline.zh: 新拉雷多—蒙特雷段完工并向游客开放；经伊达尔戈、圣路易斯波托西和塔毛利帕斯的走向确定。

timeline.en: The final alignment across the Sierra Madre between Zimapán and Tamazunchale is fixed.
timeline.zh: 锡马潘至塔马送查莱之间穿越马德雷山的最终线位敲定。

timeline.en: Work on the Colonia–Tamazunchale mountain section begins in July.
timeline.zh: 7 月，科洛尼亚—塔马送查莱山区段开工。

timeline.en: On 12 May a blast at Tamazunchale clears the last large rock; the provisional road is opened to traffic.
timeline.zh: 5 月 12 日，塔马送查莱的一次爆破清除了最后一块巨石；临时道路开放通行。

timeline.en: Contracts with companies that missed their deadlines are cancelled and the remaining work is let by the piece.
timeline.zh: 未按期完工公司的合同被解除，剩余工程改为计件发包。

timeline.en: The road is inaugurated on 1 July at the international bridge at Nuevo Laredo.
timeline.zh: 7 月 1 日，公路在新拉雷多国际桥上落成。

timeline.en: The Monterrey–Nuevo Laredo toll road is conceded to Protexa on 28 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 28 日，蒙特雷—新拉雷多收费路特许授予 Protexa。

timeline.en: Repainting of the Cómoca bridge between Ciudad Valles and Tamazunchale begins on 28 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 28 日，巴耶斯城与塔马送查莱之间的科莫卡桥涂装工程开工。
